implementation.new_relief: Unassigned candidates in CortexFlankStep reject native STOP before joining a fire team. RebalanceRoles rejects STOP for actors outside its entry participant roster, with the same predicate rechecked at publication.
implementation.retained_gap: Initial individual MOVE attribution and coordinated/owner-resume initial admission remain open. Active command receipts remain owner-local and absent from checkpoints. Identical replacement orders remain observationally indistinguishable.
implementation.active_stop: Current-drill nativeCommands records actual MOVE/HOLD issues, at most64 actors. After a recorded MOVE, STOP requires an unchanged prior owned HOLD within the original2second acknowledgement; a HOLD receipt permits next-bound transition only with matching destination/formLeader.
implementation.cleanup: CortexFlankEnd recalls native STOP only with exact current-drill HOLD receipt. MOVE or absent receipts grant no STOP cleanup authority.
implementation.move_destination: Actual main/retry/recovery requested destinations are retained independently of expectedDestination. Active MOVE must match the requested point, except unchanged post-write sampled native state during original2second acknowledgement. HOLD-to-MOVE acknowledgement remains bounded. Cleanup has no acknowledgement exemption and requires a matching MOVE target/formLeader.
implementation.natural_admission: Advance/flank/assault initial rosters reject unknown STOP; exact completed CBE holder receipts may transfer in CortexDrillStart under current state/token/epoch/generation. Old holder recall tokens/rows retire atomically. Passive transfer issues no command or new acknowledgement interval. Checked natural starts refuse an unknown STOP before first callback.
